name: Noctyra
description: A swift nocturnal predator with powerful wings, hooked talons, and an instinctive connection to the dark forest.

abilities.name: Silent Flight
abilities.description: While flying, the Noctyra gains +2 Difficulty.

abilities.name: Fade Into the Canopy
abilities.description: While in darkness or natural cover, become Hidden.

abilities.name: Ambush Predator
abilities.description: When the Noctyra successfully attacks while Hidden, deal 1d10+4 physical damage instead of its standard damage.

abilities.name: Thornclaw
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 magic damage and make the target temporarily Vulnerable.
